ROW.COLUMN: (FR/EE) Employee Front Office Transactions Between Unrelated Accounts

Institutions rely on and trust their employees to responsibly handle customer information and accounts. However, employee attempts to perpetrate fraud sometimes occur and pose a liability to the institution. An employee may create fraudulent front office transactions between unrelated accounts in an effort to consolidate funds into a common account over which they seemingly have control. The employee may also have previously executed fraudulent front office transactions to increase the available funds in the unrelated debited accounts in an attempt to hide the pattern of behavior.
This scenario monitors front office transactions made by an employee between unrelated accounts in an effort to prevent a future loss of customer assets by the employee using fraudulent and possibly undetectable means. The customer does not need to be present for the front office transactions to occur, since the fraud is perpetrated by the employee using falsified documents. All transactions of interest are carried out by the employee.

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @BUSINESS@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)

----FR_EmployeeFOTUnrelatedAccounts_RltdAccts with Trxn_Unrltd_Accts as (SELECT u.Emp_Intrl_Id, max(u.Data_Dump_Dt) over (partition by u.Emp_Intrl_Id, u.Acct_Id order by u.Emp_Intrl_Id, u.Acct_Id) as Last_Trxn_Dt, u.Acct_Id as Target_Acct_Id, u.Dbt_Side_Acct_Id FROM --FR_EmployeeEntered_UnrltdAcct_Trxn @MINER@.DSVIEW118749757 u WHERE --Unrelated Accounts coalesce(u.Unrltd_Party_Fl,'Y') <> 'N' --Lookback Period AND u.Trxn_Exctn_Dt > (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE=@Lookback_Period) AND u.Data_Dump_Dt > (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE=@Lookback_Period) ), ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Trxn_Rltd_Accts as ( SELECT distinct r.Emp_Intrl_Id, t.Target_Acct_Id, r.Dbt_Side_Acct_Id as Rltd_Acct_Id, sum(r.Trxn_Base_Am) over (partition by r.Emp_Intrl_Id, t.Target_Acct_Id order by r.Emp_Intrl_Id, t.Target_Acct_Id) as Trxn_Amt_Prior, count(r.Fo_Trxn_Seq_Id) over (partition by r.Emp_Intrl_Id, t.Target_Acct_Id order by r.Emp_Intrl_Id, t.Target_Acct_Id) as Trxn_Ct_Prior, r.Emp_Type FROM --FR_EmployeeEntered_UnrltdAcct_Trxn @MINER@.DSVIEW118749757 r inner join (select distinct Emp_Intrl_Id,Target_Acct_Id, Dbt_Side_Acct_Id, Last_Trxn_Dt from Trxn_Unrltd_Accts) t on r.Emp_Intrl_Id = t.Emp_Intrl_Id and r.Acct_Id = t.Dbt_Side_Acct_Id WHERE --Related Accounts r.Unrltd_Party_Fl = 'N' --Prior Credit Lookback and r.Data_Dump_Dt <= t.Last_Trxn_Dt and r.Data_Dump_Dt > add_days(t.Last_Trxn_Dt, -@Prior_Credit_Lookback) and r.Trxn_Exctn_Dt <= t.Last_Trxn_Dt and r.Trxn_Exctn_Dt > add_days(t.Last_Trxn_Dt, -@Prior_Credit_Lookback) )

However, employee attempts to perpetrate fraud sometimes occur and pose a liability to the institution. An employee may create fraudulent front office transactions between unrelated accounts in an effort to consolidate funds into a common account over which they seemingly have control. The employee may also have previously executed fraudulent front office transactions to increase the available funds in the unrelated debited accounts in an attempt to hide the pattern of behavior.
This scenario monitors front office transactions made by an employee between unrelated accounts in an effort to prevent a future loss of customer assets by the employee using fraudulent and possibly undetectable means. The customer does not need to be present for the front office transactions to occur, since the fraud is perpetrated by the employee using falsified documents. All transactions of interest are carried out by the employee.
